en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Hajj is completed by meeting the Imam<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Jabir who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Meeting the Imam is completion of al-Hajj.’”
